{{Quote|Does he think he can get away?|The weapons specialist|<ref name="Daughter" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Subtitles" /> served as a '''weapons specialist''' on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[captain]] [[Elk]] as part of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]].<ref name="Daughter" /> During a patrol near the [[planet]]<ref name="AudioDescription">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Segra Milo]]<ref name="Daughter" /> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"Daughter of Ferrix" takes place shortly after "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," which {{SW|url=andor-s1-e8-trivia-gallery|text="Narkina 5" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 6}} dates to [[5 BBY]].</ref> the [[cruiser]] [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|encountered]] the [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] of the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]] and caught it in a [[tractor beam]]. When Rael released clouds of shrapnel from his [[Starship|vessel]] to destroy the Imperial cruiser's forward tractor dish, the weapons specialist expressed surprise from such damage coming from a Haulcraft.<ref name="Daughter" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The weapons specialist, credited as "Weapons Spec", was portrayed by [[Harry McEntire]] in the television show ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the eleventh episode, "[[Daughter of Ferrix]],"<ref name="Daughter" /> which aired on [[November 16]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref>

McEntire originally guessed that he played a character in the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series, as the ''Andor'' series was shot under a working title. He assumed his role in ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' was cut, but later discovered his character was featured in ''Andor''.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|HarryMcentire|status/1593316319549595654|date=2022-11-17|Harry McEntire|quote=A while ago I shot a tiny part in a Star Wars show. Dream come true etc. Big projects shoot under a working title. I guessed it was Obi-Wan Kenobi, so when the show came out and I wasn't in it, I assumed I'd been cut. Anyway, turns out I'm in #Andor. What a lovely surprise.|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/3fRiw}}</ref>
